newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, spread widens on stocks.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, spread widens on stocks.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed, with the December/March spread widening on tightness in the cash market as evidenced by the drop in deliverable stocks, traders said.

The KCBT said Tuesday that stocks of deliverable HRW wheat as of November 15 in the Kansas City area numbered 4.30 million bushels, down from 4.93 million a week earlier. Deliverable stocks in Hutchinson, Kansas, also dropped.
Traders said the Dec/March spread action reflected the stocks data. The Dec/March spread widened to 33 cents bid late after having traded early at 26 cents.
"I'd say a good bit of the Dec/March spreading was short-covering tied to the stocks data," a KCBT trader said.
Wheat was mixed at midsession, with Dec gaining on signs the market was technically oversold short-term, traders said.
KCBT wheat ended three cents per bushel lower to four cents higher, with Dec up four cents at $4.24-1/2. March lost 1-3/4 cents to close at $3.91-1/4.

Traders said Man International bought 600,000 March bushels. FCC bear-spread one million March/Dec at between 28 and 30 cents. FIMAT bull-spread 600,000 Dec/March between 28 and 33 cents -- most of it at the upper end of the range.
